assets.prompt:

Exact target sense: minute (n.) — 分.
Primary request: A large simple analog classroom clock face is the only subject. No digits or text, only exactly sixty evenly spaced tiny tick marks, with twelve longer hour ticks. A single long blue minute hand points just one tiny tick clockwise beyond straight up. A pale blue ghost of its previous position points exactly straight up. Highlight the very narrow wedge BETWEEN these two adjacent minute ticks and add a tiny curved clockwise arrow across precisely that gap. The short dark hour hand is nearly horizontal toward the right and barely changes. The one-sixtieth-of-a-circle advance must be precise and highly readable. Do not highlight a whole five-minute interval.
